title: A Hybrid DeBERTa and Gated Broad Learning System for Cyberbullying Detection in English Text

bias_targets.methodology: Calculation of Generalized Mean of Bias (GMB) scores (GMB-Subgroup, GMB-BPSN, and GMB-BNSP) on the HateXplain dataset to assess performance disparities across various identity subgroups.

Qualitative failure case analysis and token-level attribution analysis to evaluate the model's ability to detect veiled discrimination and neutral-sounding assertions with discriminatory overtones (e.g., "people like you").
